vb_textbox.text: Gnomes are always paired with the same partners. In my case it was green and purple together and brown and red together. Generally red and purple were in sync with one another so, when red was bringing home the most mushrooms, so would purple. There are occasional dips in consistency with this, so when there are, try selecting the other colours as they tend to work in sync in the same way. Although there is this pattern throughout, the dominant gnomes changes so pay attention to the amount of mushrooms you are collecting. Generally under 4 is considered low and may be an indicator to test out the other gnome. Don't forget to click the space bar when in the forest!
